name: Peritya

skills.name: Rapid Overwrite
skills.description: Selects 1 enemy target within 8 tiles and deals Physical damage equal to 80% of attack to it.

skills.name: Fixed Erosion
skills.description: Selects 1 enemy within 8 tiles, dealing AoE Corrosion damage equal to 85% of attack to the target and all enemies within a 3x3 area, and dispels 1 buff.

skills.name: Domain Suppression
skills.description: Select a tile within 8 tiles as the center. Deal AoE Physical damage equal to 90% of attack to all enemy targets within 1 tile of the center and pull them 1 tile towards it. For each target hit, reduce this skill's cooldown by 1 turn.

skills.name: Multi-Compilation
skills.description: Deals AoE Corrosion damage equal to 100% of attck to all enemy targets within a 9x9 area centered on self, excluding the inner 5x5 area. For each target hit, increases damage dealt by 5%, up to 15%.

skills.name: Chain Reaction
skills.description:
When an enemy unit within range takes AoE damage from an allied unit, performs 1 instance of Action Support, dealing AoE Physical damage equal to 50% of attack and 1 point of Stability Damage, as well as gaining 1 point of Confectance Index. This effect can trigger up to 6 times per turn.

Before the attack, every 1 point of leftover mobility enhances the damage dealt by the attack by 10%, up to a maximum increase of 30%.

fortification.effect: The number of buffs that can be dispelled is increased by 2.
Effective range is increased by 1 tile.
For each enemy target hit, increase additional damage by 5%, up to a 25% increase.
The excluded area is reduced to 3x3 within the 9x9 area centered on self.
If no movement is made before performing an active attack, gain 2 points of Confectance Index after attacking.
Action Support can be triggered an additional 4 times per turn.

keys.name: Fixed Key 1 - Temporary System Maintenance
keys.effect: Gains 1 point of Confectance Index for every 10 points of stability damage dealt.

keys.name: Fixed Key 2 - Impromptu Cat and Mouse Game
keys.effect: If there is remaining mobility before attacking, gains Movement Up II  at the end of the action for 1 turn.

keys.name: Fixed Key 3 - Automatic Repair Program
keys.effect: If no movement is made before attacking, cleanses 2 debuffs from self.

keys.name: Fixed Key 4 - Lazy Resistance
keys.effect: Increases damage dealt by the active skill Domain Suppression to targets immune to displacement effects by 15%.

keys.name: Fixed Key 5 - A Brief Respite
keys.effect: Gains 3 points of Confectance Index at the start of the battle.

keys.name: Fixed Key 6 - Friendly Contact
keys.effect: Increases Stability Damage dealt to the primary target by the active skill Fixed Erosion by 4 points.

keys.name: Common Key - All Points to Damage
keys.effect: CRIT +5.0% / If an active skill hits 2 or more enemy targets, damage dealt is increased by 7%.

keys.name: Expansion Key
keys.effect:
When dealing Corrosion damage, for each debuff held by the target, increases damage dealt by 5%, up to a maximum of 25%

Multi-Compilation pulls all enemies hit towards self by 2 tiles

In a single round, for every 2 instances of Action Support performed, the next Action Support deals AoE Corrosion damage equivalent to 50% ATK and 2 Stability Damage to the target and all enemies within a 3x3 radius of the target
